lines.text: The man brought Ezekiel to the east gate, and the earth shone with the glory of the God of Israel.
Ezekiel fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
The Spirit brought Ezekiel into the inner court, and the LORD said He would dwell among Israel for a season.
Ezekiel was to describe the temple so Israel would be ashamed, and the mountain territory would be most holy.
The statutes said to give a young bull as a sin offering to the priests from the family of Eli.
